about.title: About Me
about.heading: Where I'm headed
about.description: I’m interested in cybersecurity from every angle: how attackers operate, how systems are defended, and how infrastructure is built to hold up. I’m still exploring where I fit best, and I’m looking for a role where I can learn across the field. Open to remote work or relocating anywhere in Europe, and beyond for the right opportunity.
